duration.text: The Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering at South China University of Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.The information page of valid Ordinary Passport. Visa page or Residence Permit page is required to providefor applicants currently in China.2. Notarized highest diploma or proof of expected graduation (photocopy and translated copy). Please ensurethat you submit the official degree certificates and transcripts before enrollment.3 .Notarized official transcripts from the undergraduate program onwards (photocopy and translated copy).4. Valid language certificates (only for non-Enalish speaking countries, language certificate must be valid forthe latest 2 years)chinese Medium programs:HSK Band 4 with a score of 180 or above for Science or Engineering studies;. HSK Band 5 with a score of 180 or above for Liberal Arts, Economics, Management studies, ForeignLanguages,Art,Design,Architecture, or Sports Science;HSK Band 5 with a score of 210 for journalism and Communication (Chinese Teaching and Communication)English Medium programs (for non-English speaking countries):Undergraduate level:TOEFL lBT 68 or above; lELTs 5.5 and above ; Duolingo English tests 100 scores or above; other equivalentEnglish language qualifications;Master's or doctoral level:TOEFL IBT 80 or above; lELTs 6.0 or above ;Duolingo English tests 112 scores or above; or other equivalentEnglish language qualifications (TOEFL Essentials m Scores and TOEFL MyBest Scores etc.)Those students who are exempt from submiting an English Language Certificate must meet the followingconditionsA citizen of an English-speaking countryObtain the highest-level degree of education from an institution operating in English and submitting aproof issued by the instruction5.Original copy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form (must be filled out in chinese or English, the result isonly valid for 1 year).6.A study or research plan (a minimum of 1000 words) in Chinese or English.7. Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors.8. Pre-acceptance letter signed by SCuT professors or associate professors (except for Materials Science andEngineering English taught Master program etc.).9. Doctoral applicants should submit abstract(s) of graduation theses or published papers.10. For applicants in music-related programs, include a DVD or CD of your live performance. For architecture ordesign-related programs,please submit a portfolio.11.Non-criminal record.

requirements.text: 1)Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens and be under the age of 35.2)The information page of valid Ordinary Passport. Visa page or Residence Permit page is required to providefor applicants currently in China.3)Bachelor's degree diploma and transcripts with good record. Applicants who have not graduated fromundergraduate program should provide a Pre-graduation Certificate or a testimonial indicating the expectedgraduation date (Please ensure that you submit the official dearee certificates and transcrints beforeenrollment).The language proficiency certificate must be valid at the time of enrollment and is only valid for 2 years:4)(1)Language Requirements for Chinese Medium ProgramsHSK Band 4 with 180 scores or above for Science or Engineering studies.HSK Band 5 with 180 scores or above for Lilberal Arts, Economics, Arts and Design or Management studies. HSK Band 5 with 210 scores or above for journalism and Communication (chinese Teaching andcommunication)(2) Language Requirements for English Medium Programs (only for non-English speaking countrieslanguage certificate must be valid for the latest 2 years)TOEFL IBT 80 or aboveIELTS 6.0 or aboveDuolingo English test 112 scores or above. Other equivalent English language qualifications (TOEFL Essentials m Scores and TOEFL MyBest Scoresetc.)(3)Language reguirements for Bilingual Medium programsHSK Band 4 with 180 scores or above’TOEFL IBT 80 or above, lELTS 6.0 or above, Duolingo English test 112 scores or above,Other equivalentEnglish language qualifications (only for non-English speaking countries)(4) Those students who are exempt from submiting an English Language Certificate must meet thefollowing conditionsA citizen of an English-speaking countryObtain the highest-level degree of education from an institution operating in English and submitting aproof issued by the institution(5 Original copy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form (must be filed out in Chinese or English, the result isonly valid for 1 year).(6)Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors.⑦ A pre-acceptance letter signed by SCUT professors or associate professors (except for MBA, Materials scienceand Engineering English taught program etc.).8 Astudy or research plan written in Chinese/English (1000 words minimum).(9)To apply for music related programs, please submit a DVD or CD of your live performance. To apply forarchitecture related programs or design related programs, please submit a portfolio of your work.10For MBA program applicants, you must meet one of the following conditions and pass the evaluation of MBAcenter:,Obtain at least 3 years of work experiences after the undergraduate degreeObtain at least 2 years of work experiences after the postgraduate degree
